01 — Identity

Between
worlds.

Born in Morocco, shaped by mathematics and code — I found the most interesting space lives at the edge between what is logical and what is felt.

Living in China has expanded everything. A new language, a new visual grammar, a new understanding of silence in a different culture.

I model, photograph, direct, and design — one continuous act of paying attention.

07 — Discipline

Body as
Practice

Discipline
is freedom.
The body
never lies.
Movement
is thought.
Consistency
over intensity.
Training
Strength training as meditation. Every session a conversation with yourself about who you intend to become.
Swimming
Water as the purest form of resistance. Silence beneath the surface. Breath as the only metric that matters.
Mindset
Physical discipline bleeds into creative discipline. The same presence required in the gym lives in the studio.
Aesthetics
Form and function as one. The body as a creative medium — sculpted, expressed, presented with intention.
08 — Story

Global
Journey

2000 —
Morocco · North Africa
The Origin
Born into the richness of Moroccan culture — a world of warmth, artistry, and ancient storytelling. The beginning of a story still being written.
2018 —
Morocco · University
The Discipline
Computer Science. Discovering that logic and beauty are not opposites — they are the same impulse expressed differently.
2021 —
Morocco · Creative Awakening
The Pivot
First steps into modeling, photography, and design. Technology and art were never separate — only waiting to be combined.
2023 —
China · Present
The Expansion
Relocating to China — immersed in one of the world's most dynamic creative and technological environments. Radical openness.
